end.parentNote: Asha practised identifying equal shares and naming one-third using roti, chocolate and shape examples. Nisha correctly chose equal-sized parts and explained that one-third means one equal piece out of three. They mixed up the denominator with the pieces left; this was not fully corrected by the end. At home, share a roti or fruit into equal parts and ask: “How many equal parts altogether?”
